title: Your Second Week Checkpoint
devotional: Two weeks in, it is time to pause and examine your progress. Growth is not always dramatic. Sometimes it looks like noticing a trigger earlier, walking away faster, changing your environment, or choosing a healthier response when nobody else sees it. Lamentations calls us to examine our ways and return to the Lord. Today is not about proving that you have been perfect. It is about being honest about where you are, recognizing what God has been showing you, and deciding what needs to change next.
mind_check: What have you learned about your thoughts, triggers, excuses, and patterns during the past two weeks?
body_move: Identify one physical or environmental boundary that has helped you and make a decision to keep practicing it.
spirit_move: Spend time with God without rushing. Thank Him for every area of growth and honestly surrender the areas where you are still struggling.
way_out: One change I have noticed is __________. One area I still need to work on is __________.
prayer: Father, thank You for bringing me through another week. Help me honestly examine my ways without falling into shame or pride. Show me where I have grown and where I still need Your help. Give me strength to continue, wisdom to make better choices, and a heart that keeps returning to You. Amen.
action: Review Days 8-13. Write down three things you have learned, one change you have made, one area where you still need help, and one commitment for Week 3.
